messages:
elaine_sales: quick sync re SwanBank POC — KMS/HSM questions. They want BYOK with key‑wrapping, rotation during cutover, and attestation report. Need: rotation blackout window, pen-test timing, and price delta for HSM‑proxy egress. Ping SRE/SE.
sam_engineering: noted. HSM‑proxy adds ~25–40ms per request depending on region. For batched inference paths we can get <10ms overhead. Will validate with perf tests and net egress path.
mike_sre: for cutover rotation we recommend a 2‑hour blackout per region (rolling cutover). If they require atomic rotate across replicas that's a 6–8 hour window plus one dry‑run. Also need explicit rollback playbook in the SOW.
anna_security: quick security note — questionnaire asks for key‑wrap algorithm. We support RSA‑OAEP and AES‑KWP (RFC 5649). Confirm whether SwanBank requires KMIP or direct HSM calls. If CMK stays in their HSM we need attestation + API access pattern documented.
elaine_sales: they specified AES‑KWP for key wrapping and want CEKs rotated every 24h. CMK must be stored in their HSM (BYOK). Also they asked for an HSM attestation artifact and access to audit‑grade event exports.
jordan_legal: we can provide HSM vendor attestation and a generic attestation statement. We cannot provide customer‑specific internal audit logs, but we can export logs to their SIEM (via secure S3 or syslog) under an export SLA. Need to know if they require signed timestamps.
sam_engineering: pen‑test scheduling: we prefer pen tests after staging dry‑run. Request 2 weeks notice; we'll reserve a 4h acceptance window and 24–48h monitoring. Also: provide sample curl for attestation so security team can validate during POC.
finance_ops: pricing delta: HSM‑proxy + BYOK + attestation packaging => baseline uplift. Ballpark: +$35k/mo for reserved capacity in region + $8k one‑time for attestation packaging and engineering validation. 10% discount available for 12‑month commit; final depends on sustained QPS.
elaine_sales: action items — (1) Sam: perf matrix + network egress checklist, (2) Mike: blackout plan + rollback steps, (3) Jordan: attestation wording and export SLA language, (4) Finance: draft preliminary quote and options. I will combine and send to SwanBank. Target: EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: ticket created: SB-7412 KMS BYOK POC - assignees sam_engineering,mike_sre,jordan_legal,finance_ops
sam_engineering: ack. I'll upload perf numbers and drop a tiny example for attest into SB-7412: ```curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood.dev/v1/hsm/attest```
